title: End-to-end test with real patatt
description: Use patatt from ~/GIT/patatt (dev-only, run from source) as the independent oracle: sign a patch with patatt using a registry person's ssh key, point patatt at the exported keyring (dir and ref: forms), validate. Cover: endorsed email + current key passes; revoked key fails; unendorsed email fails; key not in registry fails; automation key per decision.
acceptance_criteria: All cases behave as specified using unmodified patatt; fully offline.
notes: Now tests the patatt fork with keyringsrc=vouch: (Mark 2026-10-22 reversed P5). Stock patatt remains the oracle for signature format: a patch signed by stock patatt must verify in the fork and vice versa.
